Alex W: Proposal: treat canary switches as a 3-way protocol (controller -> worker -> synchronizer) to avoid partial handoffs. Thoughts?

Priya N: Yes. Give out a short-lived synchronizer_token signed by controller. Workers validate token locally before draining. Idempotent transfers.

Sam G: Add an eviction_quota to cap forced-kills, e.g. "eviction_quota: 20%/min". Prevents mass session blowups.

Elaine C: We need probe aggregation semantics: PASS|WARN|FAIL + score. Controller should run a windowed majority before issuing token.

Jordan: Token should be HMAC with TTL so workers can verify without cross-region calls. Fallback mode if verify fails: route new traffic to fallback variant, avoid killing sessions.

Priya N: Observability: emit synchronizer_event (token_id, origin, target, reason) for audits.

rollout-bot: rollout: synchronizer prototype rolled to canary-pool-3, observability on.

Alex W: Action items: Priya draft RFC for token + probe contract; Sam implement local HMAC lib; Elaine update SDK backoff; Jordan design cross-region modes. Keep rollout behind feature flag.
